notes.preserved_features: Existing infinite air jumps, light wings, black silhouette, contact parry, hit recoil and attack profiles remain authoritative.
notes.dodge_immunity: Movement can link after the active dodge ends, but a .23s immunity grant needs an additional .10s interval before another grant.
notes.climb: Entering a grip consumes the grab tap; an intentional pair after grabbing can still dodge off the chain.
